picks.editorial_note: An MIT-led team secured up to $53 million from ARPA-H to use generative AI for discovering safer herbicide alternatives — a large federal bet on AI-driven chemistry with direct agricultural and environmental impact.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: A Case Western-led, NIH-funded multi-institutional team is combining satellite imaging, health data, and AI to probe environmental drivers of Alzheimer's and dementia, applying AI to a major unresolved public health question.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC researchers built WorldParticle, a single deep-learning model that simulates wildly different physical phenomena — from sand to protein folding — a genuinely novel unifying approach to physics simulation.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and CMU developed 'Workspace Models,' a new memory mechanism letting robots recall relevant past observations cheaply, addressing a core bottleneck in long-horizon robot learning.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: TUM is anchoring a new German national mobility research center with up to €20 million in federal funding to test autonomous public transit, marking a significant government investment in applied AI/robotics infrastructure.
picks.title: Autonomous Public Transportation: TUM Opens New DZM Location in Munich

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to commercialize sovereign AI research — spanning physical AI, agentic AI, and cybersecurity — reflects a national push to translate academic AI work into industrial and security applications.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics firm Unitree, building toward a joint lab, signals deepening academia-industry integration in embodied AI, a fast-moving and strategically important subfield.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Google.org funding for ANU to modernize fusion simulation software with AI pairs a major tech company's resources with fusion energy research, a high-stakes application area for AI-accelerated science.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: A $4.2 million NIST award lets SMU build a Digital Twin lab combining AI, robotics, and HPC for semiconductor manufacturing and workforce training, tying federal funding directly to chip-industry workforce needs.
picks.title: SMU awarded $4.2 million to advance AI-driven manufacturing and workforce training

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's 'Genesis Agent Skills' release, developed with Fermilab, automates documentation and benchmarking for scientific ML projects — a concrete step in the federal Genesis Mission's push to scale AI across national labs.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission
